entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello Alex. I'm calling about an order I received last month. I bought a cycling jersey, and I need to send it back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro-Vent Jersey, delivered 37 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a sizing issue. I ordered my usual medium, but this jersey is just way too tight across the shoulders. I must have gotten the wrong size.
I see. So you're looking for an exchange or a return. Let me just check the policy for you.
Yes, an exchange for a large would be ideal.

Okay, thanks for your patience. It looks like you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window, so I can absolutely authorize this return for you. The fastest way to get your new item is to return this one for a full refund and then place a new order for the correct size.
That's good to hear. Now, since I'll have to pay for shipping again on the new order, and there was this sizing issue, could you perhaps add a 15% discount code to my account for the trouble?

I appreciate you asking, but I'm not able to add a discount for a standard size exchange. Our policy is to provide a full refund for the item once it's returned. I can generate a prepaid shipping label for you right now so there's no cost to send the jersey back.
Alright, I understand. A prepaid label is fair. So, you'll email that to me?
That's correct. The email with the label and return instructions is on its way to you now. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. Thank you for making it easy.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
